_comment: Copy to config.json and deploy it alongside index.html. It prefills the two
endpoint URLs so someone handed a link only has to paste the tokens.
Deliberately holds no secrets: this file is served publicly. The approval
token and the admin token stay out of it and are pasted by the visitor.
Both are Lambda Function URLs. The page works without this file, so opening
index.html straight from disk still behaves as it always did.
